_comment: Character voice assignments for Narrator v0. Edit this file to add/modify character voices. Each entry maps a character name (as it appears in [Name] dialogue tags) to a Qwen3 VoiceDesign description. New NPCs not in this file get a default voice based on gender detection.
narrator: A skilled storyteller with a warm, measured voice. Speaks at a steady pace with clear enunciation and subtle emotional inflection. Like a professional audiobook narrator — engaging but not theatrical, letting the words carry the weight.
Kael: A grizzled veteran warrior with a deep, gravelly voice. Speaks in short, clipped sentences. Battle-hardened and world-weary, but not without warmth.
Lyra: A young mage with a bright, curious voice. Slightly higher pitch, speaking with eager intelligence. Quick to excitement when discussing magic or lore.

_defaults.male: A male character voice, natural and conversational. Not reading text aloud — speaking as the character in the moment. Adapts tone to the situation.
_defaults.female: A female character voice, natural and conversational. Not reading text aloud — speaking as the character in the moment. Adapts tone to the situation.
